reason: In packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:147-149, selectedCalendar is `destinationCalendar?.find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, so it can be undefined. Line 154 falls back to `selectedCalendar || "primary"`, but the hangout-link `calendar.events.patch` at line 168 passes the bare `calendarId: selectedCalendar`, so that patch call gets undefined. Before this change, the value defaulted to "primary".
